definition: The fixed-point closure of the generalized stress flow from the seed {4: [I4_1], 6: [I6_2], 8: [I8_3, I8_4, I8_5, I8_6]}, in the verified degree-10 basis. A target activates once every factor of its coefficient monomial is reachable.

span_of_all_degree10_targets.why_different: includes Tr(tau) and every coefficient monomial, with no activation condition; quotient would be 0

new_forcing_space.why_different: excludes Tr(tau) as a generator entirely

static_stress_span.why_different: the static span is not the dynamically reachable set

arithmetic: exact rational closure and elimination over Q (fractions.Fraction)

lower_bound.route: rank over F_p is a lower bound on rank over Q

upper_bound.route: the closure is computed over Q and its rank read off by exact rational elimination, so the value is the rank, not a bound

scope_caveat: D_d is a SEED closure. The generator-extension problem dV/dlambda = f(T,S,lambda) is different and is not answered here.
